title: 第17章 熊灵兽第18章 她承认了
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
黎漠神情骤变，眉眼间染上一丝怒气。
这两人，还真是胆大包天！
他上前就要拦住两人。
然而。
宋荞的反应速度，比她更快。
宋荞手中，噼里啪啦，朝着那两只灵兽，就扔出来一堆符箓！
刹那间。
一道道雷霆冲天而降！
三阶雷符！
三阶雷符！
宋荞这一把，竟然全是三阶雷符！
一张两张三阶雷符，这两只灵兽还能抵挡，一堆雷符下来，两只灵兽只是挣扎了一瞬间，就生生被劈晕了过去！
“小虎！”林颜有些紧张地把霸天虎抱了起来，她愤怒地看着宋荞：“小虎才出生没多久，还是一个孩子！你竟对一个孩子，下这种狠手！宋荞，你还是人吗？”
楚风眠看也没看地上的火尾狗一眼，一脸阴冷地看着宋荞：“整整十三张雷符，宋荞，你倒是舍得！”
宋荞笑了笑，下一刻，手中又出现了一堆雷符：“没办法呀，谁让我身家雄厚，各种宝物多得花不完呢？对了！我能有今日的身家，还得感谢你们的倾力相助呢。”
“宋荞！小虎要是个好歹，我不会放过你的，师尊不会放过你的，就连神兽大人也不会放过你的！”林颜厉声说道。
宋荞翻了个白眼，正要说些什么。
黎漠冷漠的声音响了起来：“林师妹！请你慎言！今日种种，我看得清清楚楚，是谁先行挑衅，是谁先行动手，我自会在所有人面前说个明白。”
“大师兄！”林颜咬了咬牙，顿时露出一个委屈的神情：“我只是不想宋师姐再次惹怒神兽，想要让她离开罢了。”
“宋师妹的事情，就不劳你们操心了。”黎漠冷声说道，转身看向宋荞时，眉眼又不由柔和了下来：“宋师妹，今日不是沐浴日，我们直接去住所。等日光猫大人吸收完第一缕晨光，他们就会回来的。”

“好的。”宋荞应了下来。
黎漠带着宋荞，竟是径自离开了。
林颜摸着怀中昏迷过去的霸天虎，眸底闪过一丝冷色。
楚风眠嫌弃地将地上的火尾狗收回了御灵空间。
他这火尾狗，有着筑基巅峰的修为。但是，它只是中等灵兽，论起战斗力，竟是和刚出生的霸天虎差不多。
要不说宋方那个老匹夫偏心呢？
他的资质，比起宋荞不知道要好上多少。结果呢，宋方只给找来中等灵兽，却给宋荞千辛万苦找来高等灵兽。
就这，还想让他死心塌地？
“楚师兄，我们也过去。”林颜说道：“待会等面见了神兽大人，宋荞的事情，我们再好好说道说道！”
“不错。”楚风眠眸光闪动。
如果是神兽大人出手惩治了宋荞，哪怕是宋方，又能说什么？
神兽居所。
黎漠好奇地问道：“宋师妹，今天你打算如何改造？”
他现在对宋荞，已经没有质疑，只有信服。
“先找一个空旷的地方。我们先……”宋荞正说着。
突然。
烦人的声音又响了起来。
“这是怎么回事，神兽居所怎么变成这个样子了？”
“好好的柱子，怎么用一团团草围了起来！”
“这几个球是什么玩意儿！用来踢的吗？”

“你看那边，谁用一堆木头，乱七八糟搭出了一颗巨树？”
林颜和楚风眠旁若无人地议论着。
黎漠皱眉看了他们一眼：“你们闭上嘴巴，老实等着神兽大人接见就是了！”
他自认对宗门所有师弟师妹都是公平公正，楚风眠和林颜，却硬是让他生出了一种将两人套麻袋打一顿的冲动。
“大师兄，这就是昨天神兽突然暴怒的原因吧？”楚风眠挑了挑眉：“好好的雕梁画柱被你们搞成这个样子，神兽大人能喜欢就怪了。”
content_en:
Li Mo's expression suddenly changed, and there was a trace of anger in his eyebrows.
These two people are really brave!
He stepped forward to stop the two of them.
However.
Song Qiao's reaction speed was faster than hers.
Song Qiao's hands crackled and he threw a bunch of talismans towards the two spiritual beasts!
In an instant.
Thunderbolts soared down from the sky!
Third level thunder talisman!
Third level thunder talisman!
Song Qiao's handful was actually a third-level thunder talisman!
One or two third-level thunder talismans, these two spirit beasts were able to resist. When a bunch of thunder talismans came down, the two spirit beasts only struggled for a moment, and were knocked unconscious!
"Little Tiger!" Lin Yan nervously picked up the Decepticon. She looked at Song Qiao angrily: "Little Tiger was born not long ago, and he is still a child! You actually do such cruel things to a child! Song Qiao, are you still a human?"
Chu Fengmian didn't even look at the fire-tailed dog on the ground, and looked at Song Qiao with a cold expression: "Three thunder talismans, Song Qiao, you are willing to bear them!"
Song Qiao smiled, and the next moment, a bunch of thunder talismans appeared in his hand: "I can't help it. Who made me rich and have so many treasures that I can't spend them all? That's right! I can have the wealth I have today thanks to your help."
"Song Qiao! If Xiaohu is good or bad, I will not let you go. Master will not let you go. Even the sacred beast will not let you go!" Lin Yan said sternly.
Song Qiao rolled his eyes and was about to say something.
Li Mo's cold voice rang out: "Junior sister Lin! Please be careful what you say! Today, I can clearly see who provoked and acted first. I will make it clear in front of everyone."
"Elder brother!" Lin Yan gritted his teeth and suddenly showed a wronged expression: "I just don't want Senior Sister Song to anger the divine beast again and want her to leave."
"Junior Sister Song, I don't need you to worry about it." Li Mo said coldly. When he turned to look at Song Qiao, his eyebrows softened again: "Junior Sister Song, today is not a bathing day, so we will go directly to the residence. They will come back after Mr. Sunshine Cat has absorbed the first ray of morning light."
"Okay." Song Qiao responded.
Li Mo took Song Qiao and left alone.
Lin Yan touched the unconscious Decepticon in his arms, a cold look flashed in his eyes.
Chu Fengmian took the fire-tailed dog on the ground back to the spirit space in disgust.
He, the fire-tailed dog, has a cultivation base at the peak of foundation building. However, it is only a medium-sized spiritual beast. In terms of combat power, it is actually about the same as a newborn Decepticon.
How about saying that the old man Song Fang is partial?
His qualifications are much better than Song Qiao's. As a result, Song Fang only found medium spiritual beasts, but Song Qiao went through a lot of hard work to find high-level spiritual beasts.
Just like that, you still want him to give up?
"Senior Brother Chu, let's go over too." Lin Yan said: "We will meet the Master Divine Beast later, and we will have a good talk about Song Qiao!"
"Not bad." Chu Fengmian's eyes flashed.
If Lord Divine Beast punished Song Qiao, what could even Song Fang say?
The abode of mythical beasts.
Li Mo asked curiously: "Junior Sister Song, how do you plan to transform today?"
He now has no doubts about Song Qiao, only conviction.
"First find an open place. Let's first..." Song Qiao was saying.
Sudden.
The annoying sound started again.
"What's going on? Why did the beast's residence become like this?"
"What a great pillar, why are it surrounded by balls of grass?"
"What are these balls! Are they used for kicking?"
"Look over there, who built a giant tree out of a pile of wood?"
Lin Yan and Chu Fengmian were discussing as if no one else was watching.
Li Mo frowned and glanced at them: "Shut your mouths and just wait for the Lord Divine Beast to receive you!"
He believed that he was fair and just to all his junior brothers and sisters in the sect, but Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan were stubbornIt gave him the urge to put sacks on the two of them and beat them up.
"Elder brother, is this the reason why the mythical beast suddenly became angry yesterday?" Chu Fengmian raised his eyebrows: "You have turned a fine carved pillar into this, it's strange that the mythical beast likes it."
